description: Located in Bang Kung subdistrict, Bang Khonthi district, this area was once set up as a military camp called “Kai Bang Kung” for troops from southern provinces to fight against Burmese army. After the fall of the Ayutthaya kingdom, King Taksin restored this camp to base Chinese soldiers, and renamed it “Kai Chin Bang Kung”.
